newsitem.title: POLAND: Sumitomo to arrange loan for BPH.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo to arrange loan for BPH.

text.p: Japan's Sumitomo Bank Ltd will lead an international banking consortium which will arrange a syndicated loan for Poland's Bank Przemyslowo-Handlowy (BPH), BPH President Henryka Pieronkiewicz said on Wednesday.
Pieronkiewicz told a news conference the loan will increase BPH's credit action and money market operations at a low cost.
BPH said in a statement after the conference that details of the loan were still being ironed out.
Pieronkiewicz did not give the value of the loan but last month a banker close to the deal said BPH asked Sumitomo to arrange a $75 million loan. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
